name: Pontine Autosomal Dominant Microangiopathy with Leukoencephalopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Pontine Autosomal Dominant Microangiopathy with Leukoencephalopathy

criteria.description: Progressive neurological symptoms including gait disturbance and cognitive decline
MRI evidence of pontine microangiopathy and diffuse leukoencephalopathy
Autosomal dominant inheritance pattern with affected first-degree relatives
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with cerebral microangiopathy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of progressive neurological symptoms, characteristic MRI findings, and positive family history consistent with autosomal dominant inheritance
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing can support diagnosis but is not mandatory if clinical and imaging criteria are met.
